lines.beaver: 선생님, 태종이 셋째에게 왕위를 준 건 어때요?
lines.beaver_en: Teacher, what about King Taejong giving the throne to his third son?
lines.beaver_roman: seonsaengnim, taejongi setjjaeege wangwireul jun geon eottaeyo?
lines.learner: 장자 계승 원칙을 깬 선택이라 평가가 갈려요.
lines.en: It broke the rule of eldest-son succession, so opinions are divided.
lines.roman: jangja gyeseung wonchigeul kkaen seontaegira pyeonggaga gallyeoyo.

lines.learner: 네, 신하들은 장남이 왕위를 이어야 한다고 했어요.
lines.en: Yes, the subjects said the eldest son should take the throne.
lines.roman: ne, sinhadeureun jangnami wangwireul ieoya handago haesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then why did he choose the third son?
lines.learner: 셋째는 책을 사랑하는 선비 같은 사람이었거든요.
lines.en: The third son was like a scholar who loved books.
lines.roman: setjjaeneun chaegeul saranghaneun seonbi gateun saramieotgeodeunyo.

lines.learner: 한글을 만든 위인이 되었으니 좋은 선택이었죠.
lines.en: He became the great man who made Hangeul, so it was a good choice.
lines.roman: hangeureul mandeun wiini doeeosseuni joeun seontaegieotjyo.

lines.beaver: 그런데 태종은 피를 흘리며 왕이 됐잖아요?
lines.beaver_en: But Taejong became king through bloodshed, right?
lines.beaver_roman: geureonde taejongeun pireul heullimyeo wangi dwaetjanayo?
lines.learner: 네, 형제끼리 싸운 왕자의 난이 있었죠.
lines.en: Yes, there were the Strife of the Princes, when brothers fought.
lines.roman: ne, hyeongjekkiri ssaun wangjae nani isseotjyo.

lines.beaver: 그런 아버지 밑에서 세종은 어떻게 자랐어요?
lines.beaver_en: How did Sejong grow up under such a father?
lines.beaver_roman: geureon abeoji miteseo sejongeun eotteoke jarasseoyo?
lines.learner: 책을 많이 읽고 아랫사람 말도 귀담아들었대요.
lines.en: They say he read a lot and listened carefully to those below him.
lines.roman: chaegeul mani ilkko araetsaram maldo gwidamadeureotdaeyo.

lines.beaver: 이 일에서 무엇을 배울 수 있을까요?
lines.beaver_en: What can we learn from this?
lines.beaver_roman: i ireseo mueoseul baeul su isseulkkayo?
lines.learner: 역사의 흐름을 보면 알 수 있는 게 있어요.
lines.en: There's something you can see when you look at the flow of history.
lines.roman: yeoksae heureumeul bomyeon al su inneun ge isseoyo.

lines.learner: 좋은 지도자가 선조들의 삶을 바꿨다는 거예요.
lines.en: That good leaders changed our ancestors' lives.
lines.roman: joeun jidojaga seonjodeure salmeul bakkwotdaneun geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Were there such people in colonial times too?
lines.learner: 네, 편한 삶보다 독립운동을 택한 분들이 있었죠.
lines.en: Yes, some people chose the independence movement over an easy life.
lines.roman: ne, pyeonhan salmboda dongnibundongeul taekan bundeuri isseotjyo.

lines.beaver_en: Today's class was really fun. Thank you!
lines.learner: 짧은 시간이나마 도움이 됐다니 기뻐요. 잘 가요.
lines.en: I'm glad it helped, even if only for a short time. Take care.
lines.roman: jjalbeun siganinama doumi dwaetdani gippeoyo. jal gayo.
